thread:
kevin: Heads up — release cut blocked. CI artifact verification failing on the linux wheel upload step. deploy-bot auto-aborted the promotion. 

kevin: error shows mismatch in archive checksum, looks like streaming upload got truncated. Seen this once before with the s3 proxy.

ci-bot: [automated] upload-step: failed to verify artifact checksum (expected=sha256:abcd1234 got=sha256:abcf0000). See job 7821 logs: https://ci.internal/7821 

anna: Ugh. Which image/tag are we holding? Do we have a previous good build to pin to?

kevin: deploy-bot attempted to promote redwood/api@2026-03-22-rc2 but it was aborted. There's a last-good at redwood/api@2026-03-20-rc7.

sam: Quick triage: is this a transient S3 error or a build pipeline producing corrupt tar? We should check the uploader and the CI runner's disk.

kevin: I pulled a curl of the uploaded wheel and got EOF mid-file. Remote size=4,120,384 bytes but local expected=4,524,192.

kevin: log snippet:
```
[upload-stream] INFO starting multipart upload
[upload-stream] WARN premature EOF after 4120384 bytes
[verify] ERROR checksum mismatch: expected sha256:abcd1234 got sha256:abcf0000
```

anna: ops-oncall can you check s3 proxy and LB metrics? If the proxy is cutting connections we need to stop promotions until fixed.

ops-oncall: Looking now — upstream S3 shows 200s but our proxy in eu-west saw several 502s around 03:14UTC. I'm restarting the proxy pod to clear keepalive state.

ops-oncall: quick fix deployed (proxy restart). I'm rerunning the CI upload job 7821 on the same runner to verify.

ci-bot: job 7821 re-run queued.

sam: If rerun succeeds we can re-promote. If it fails again, we should pin to 2026-03-20-rc7 and open a follow-up to investigate runner IO.

ci-bot: job 7821 (rerun) started on runner-14.

kevin: To be safe for the change window, I propose manual pin to rc7 so customers don't get delayed. We can hotfix the rc2 later if needed. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

anna: Agree with manual pin for now. We have a scheduled DB migration at 05:00UTC; don't want to delay it. Pin, record in release notes that rc2 failed artifact verification and will be reattempted.

sam: +1 pin. I'll make the promote call to deploy-bot to pin to redwood/api@2026-03-20-rc7 and annotate the rollout notes.

kevin: Thanks. sam please also create an issue with steps to reproduce: upload from runner-14 -> multipart upload -> verify, include checksums and runner logs.

sam: Will do. Calling deploy-bot now: /promote redwood/api@2026-03-20-rc7 --reason "manual pin after rc2 artifact checksum failure"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Will run pre-promotion checks and update status.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — redwood/api@2026-03-20-rc7 is now promoted to candidate. Release notes updated: "Promotion pinned to last known-good after artifact verification failure on newer candidate."

ci-bot: job 7821 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS. Uploaded artifact verified OK on rerun.

kevin: Nice — rerun succeeded, but we've already pinned to stay within change window. We'll plan a secondary promotion after post-release validation once a small hotfix pipeline is green.

anna: Filing follow-up: ISSUE-987: investigate intermittent upload truncation on runner-14 and add checksum preflight in uploader. Assigning to sam.

sam: Filed ISSUE-987 and added initial triage notes + logs.

ops-oncall: I'll keep an eye on proxy metrics and collect tcpdump if it recurs.

kevin: Good work team. Action items: sam - create repro and triage (ISSUE-987), ops-oncall - monitor proxy + collect traces, anna - confirm release notes and change window owner. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
